scan_scope: generation-time workspace set at artifact-generation time (artifacts/*.json + compiler_raw/*.txt + compiler_raw/compiled/* + the contract); the COMMITTED TREE scan count is recorded separately by POST_COMMIT_REMOTE_READBACK_RECEIPT.committed_tree_secret_scan
digest_like_hex_exclusion_policy: pure 32/40/64-char lowercase hex values are SHA-1/SHA-256 digests, not secrets; they are excluded from the high-entropy class and counted here rather than silently dropped
low_entropy_exclusion_policy: paths/identifiers are structurally excluded: a token must be an unbroken [A-Za-z0-9+=]{24,} run, so '/' '.' '_' '-' break it
